QuestInfo.name: Mother's Gold Watch
QuestInfo.1: At the entrance of #m10001000#, I met #p402#'s father #p202#, the chief of #m10001000#. He was even more ornery and difficult to talk to than I'd anticipated, but I finally convinced him to accept #p402# back home with open arms. I also got #p402#'s late mother's #b#t4031006##k as proof. Now, all I need to do is deliver this watch to #p402# in #m10003000#.
QuestInfo.2: I gave #p402# his late mother's #b#t4031006##k. As a sign of appreciation, he gave me an earring he received from friends he met while traveling. Well, #p202# forgave #p402#, but it doesn't seem like #p402# plans to head home right away. Maybe I should keep an eye open next time I'm in #m10001000#.

0.0: It's a special watch. Make sure you don't lose it. #p402# is in #m10003000#, right? Please... please take care of this and... and him. So long.

1.0: What? You convinced my father to let me return? That's unbelievable... I'm amazed that you changed the mind of Mr. Holier-Than-Thou. Now I can say goodbye to the life of a wanderer. Thank you so much!
1.1: Whoa, this #t4031006# is... it's my mother's, for sure. I should have been better to her when she was alive... Anyway, you did me a huge favor, so here! It isn't much, but take it.

yes.0: I got this earring from friends I met while traveling all around the island. Might as well look good traveling, right? Hehe... Hopefully it'll help you on your journey.

npc.0: You haven't been to see #p402# yet? Please give the #t4031006# to him. Don't lose it!

item.0: You haven't met my father yet? He's the chief of #m10001000#. Please convince him to let me return home. And as a sign of proof, please get the #t4031006# my mother left behind...

lost.0: Oh my, did you lose the #t4031006#? I told you to be careful! Luckily, a townsman found it on the street. Here, take it again, and PLEASE don't lose it this time.
